name: kitao/pyxel
description: A retro game engine for Python inspired by PICO-8 and TIC-80, featuring a 16-color palette, 4-channel audio, and built-in sprite/sound editors. Makes pixel-art game creation accessible to Python developers.
score_rationale: The most accessible retro fantasy console for Python developers with 17.4k stars, MIT-licensed and actively maintained.
summary: Python-based retro fantasy console with pixel-art tools and editing
